verdict.rationale: Floot's platform docs say apps get Google or Microsoft sign-in through OAuth that Floot brokers, with no developer account of your own to register, so social login is built in. The pack never mentions email/password sign-up or how the builder scaffolds login screens and user tables. Social providers are limited to Google and Microsoft. Missing for 10: evidence of email/password sign-up and login, documentation of builder-scaffolded auth UI and user tables, social providers beyond Google/Microsoft, independent or hands-on corroboration.
